visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair, wearing a dark green crew-neck t-shirt, sits in a well-lit indoor environment against a plain, off-white wall. He looks directly at the camera lens with a neutral yet slightly focused facial expression, as if reading something. Pink text overlays are visible at the top center of the frame. (2) A second person, a woman with long dark hair, suddenly emerges from within the man's shirt collar, peeking her head out and looking upward. The man's expression shifts from neutral to a broad, teeth-showing smile as he looks down at her. He uses his right hand to pull the neckline of the shirt higher. (3) The woman attempts to peek out again, appearing determined, while the man continues to laugh and smile brightly, eventually placing his hand firmly over the collar area to obscure her view. Yellow variety-style text appears briefly at the bottom center of the frame as they maintain their positions.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio track opens with four consecutive high-pitched, digital notification chime effects. Each chime has a fast attack and a clean decay, separated by roughly one second of silence. There is no background music, leaving only a faint, low-level indoor ambient room tone. (2) A woman's voice suddenly cuts in with high arousal and a sharp, inquisitive rising intonation pattern, speaking clearly in Mandarin. This is immediately met with the sound of a male laughing, characterized by a series of rhythmic, breathy aspirations and a bright, friendly vocal tone. (3) The woman repeats a single-word question with even higher vocal pitch and emphasis. The laughter from the male continues, overlapping with the sound of continuous fabric-on-fabric rustling, suggesting close physical proximity and movement. The room tone remains consistently quiet throughout the ending.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To entertain the audience through a humorous 'Point of View' (POV) scenario. The video relies on the visual surprise of a partner hiding in a shirt to mimic a 'pestering' or 'curious' dynamic when a notification sounds, creating a warm and relatable comedic moment.
